notes.title: Update v1.1.0 - Ultimate Gauntlets!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I hope you've all been enjoying the game! This first major post-release update adds the Ultimate Gauntlet. This is effectively speedrunning the game without CarsOS segments. Hope to see you all on the leaderboards :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32417737/dd2fa51c3cadba42fb9480f8d606d4c58984ed84.png[/img]

[h2]Steathscape v1.1.0[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the Ultimate Gauntlet. Play through every Stage in the Campaign back to back, with it's own timed leaderboards!
[*] Gauntlet buttons are now visible when you've completed the World instead of every Stage in the World
[*] Fixed music not looping properly if you skipped a stage from a previous world
[*] Moved a few Gold Coins so they're easier to find
[*] Various minor changes/bug fixes
[/list]

If you have any suggestions for future updates of Stealthscape, join [url=https://discord.gg/stealthscape]the Discord[/url] and drop them in the #suggestions channel!

If you want to learn more about this update or future updates, visit the [url=https://trello.com/b/h69qJjRQ/stealthscape]Stealthscape Trello[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/stealthscape]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Stealthscape v1.0.0 - AVAILABLE NOW!!!
notes.content:
Hey all! Today marks the full release of Stealthscape! This brings the game's Campaign to a complete state. I still plan on releasing content updates outside of the Campaign such as the Stage Editor, Customization, bug fixes, and more. Bring any and all suggestions/bug reports you may have to the [url=https://discord.gg/stealthscape]Official Stealthscape Discord[/url]! This update officially brings the game to 120 Campaign Stages, 35 Bonus Stages, and 80 Customization Unlocks!

[b]GET THE GAME AT A 25% DISCOUNT UNTIL OCTOBER 27th![/b]

[previewyoutube=yzSpR8GM7-0;full][/previewyoutube]

Get Stealthscape now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/670720/Stealthscape/

Additionally, you can also get the game's Soundtrack here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390100/Soundscape__Stealthscape_OST/

[list]
[*] Added World H
[*] Added World H's post-world content
[*] 25 Stages have been changed/revamped and have had leaderboards wiped as a result
[*] Added 3 new songs
[*] Added controller support to all the menus + STLTHSCPE
[*] Implemented all Steam Achievements
[*] Updated the art for a few objects
[*] You now get notifications for Gold Coin pickups
[*] Added new Ship, Trail, Palette, and FX Customizations
[*] Re-ordered all the Customization Unlocks
[*] Gauntlet Runs now show time for your HUD regardless of your HUD setting
[*] Doppelgangers now show above your trail
[*] Various additional changes/bug fixes
[/list]
[h3]Steathscape v1.0.0a[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game now saves which page of the leaderboard you were looking at
[*] Fixed an issue with World C's CarsOS
[/list]

Thank you all for following me on this journey, and I hope you enjoy Full Release! See you all on the leaderboards ;)

If you want to learn more about this update or future updates, visit the [url=https://trello.com/b/h69qJjRQ/stealthscape]Stealthscape Trello[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/stealthscape]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Stealthscape v1.0.0 - COMING OCTOBER 20th!!!
notes.content:
Stealthscape is reaching the final stages of development, and I'm happy to say the game will enter Full Release on the 20th of October 2020!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32417737/fd3b6ba383c5fdaec2815bf39eb6e716d781f7ff.png[/img]

Here's a list of what to expect from v1.0.0:

[list]
[*] Full Controller Support
[*] World H
[*] World H's post-world content
[*] 3 new Music Tracks
[*] More Palettes to unlock
[*] 8 new Ships to unlock
[*] 10 new Trails to unlock
[*] New FX Customizations
[*] The ability to beat the game
[/list]

On top of all this, Stealthscape will release alongside [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390100/Soundscape__Stealthscape_OST/]"Soundscape", Stealthscape's OST[/url], which you can buy for $1.99 if you'd like to use the music in your own projects (with credit) or to support me :)

When v1.0.0 releases, your existing save data will be wiped past World B. Meaning if you've completed every stage thus far, when v1.0.0 releases, you'll only have Worlds A and B completed, with C unlocked. Leaderboards for each and every stage will remain (as long as the stage hasn't been heavily modified)

I hope you're all as hyped as I am! Don't forget to wishlist the game if you haven't already!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/670720/Stealthscape/

notes.title: 2 Weeks until Early Access!
notes.content:
Only 2 more weeks until Stealthscape comes to Early Access. The release date is March 30th, so don't forget and add to wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/670720/Stealthscape/

Time to answer some more questions that have been left unanswered

[h2]How much will Stealthscape cost?[/h2]

The game will cost $9.99 USD while in Early Access, and during the first week the game is available there will be a 10% discount. However, you can pre-order the game right now at https://carsonk.itch.io/stealthscape to get a Steam Key that will unlock on launch.


[h2]Will the game be available for Mac/Linux?[/h2]

During Early Access, there will be no Mac or Linux versions of the game. However, if there is enough demand, a Mac and/or Linux version will be considered for the full release.


[h2]Will the game have DLC or updates AFTER Early Access?[/h2]

Once the game is released from Early Access, bug fixes and minor content updates will continue to come for free, as well as more stages to play once you've completed the Campaign.


Hope to see you all on the leaderboards on March 30th!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/670720/Stealthscape/

notes.title: STEALTHSCAPE EARLY ACCESS - MARCH 30
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=4cTWV_0cQmM;full][/previewyoutube]

Stealthscape is finally coming to Steam in Early Access! Add to wishlist and mark your calendars, cause the big day's [b]March 30th, 2020[/b]

[h2]What Does Early Access Mean?[/h2]

After years of development, Stealthscape is in a fully playable state and is near fully-featured. But the Campaign will require more time to complete, and there's still so much planned for the game. But not only that, there's potentially so much YOU will have planned for the game. If you have any feature requests, new object ideas, issues, bugs or what have you, feel free to [b][url=https://discord.gg/MTeq58B]join our discord[/url][/b] and let me know in the [b]#feedback[/b] channel, I want this game to be the best it can be and I can't do that alone.


[h2]What's in the Early Access version?[/h2]
[list]
[*]2 Worlds in the Campaign (At Launch)
[*]Gold Coins to find throughout the Campaign stages
[*]Story-based missions you encounter between each world
[*]Gauntlet Runs that have you speedrun through an entire world in one sitting
[*]A fully-featured Stage Editor with limitless options and features
[*]Steam Workshop support for sharing custom stages
[*]An XP/Customization Unlock system that allows you to customize your ship with different models, trails, and FX
[/list]
There will also be a weekly branch available which will contain more unstable builds, but you will get content as it's being developed. Development is being shared in the discord constantly.


[h2]What's to come?[/h2]
[list]
[*]More Campaign worlds (9 in total)
[*]A Story completed in missions between worlds throughout the game
[*]More objects, enemies and traps to create stages with
[*]More customization unlocks for your ship
[*]Gameplay modifiers that fundamentally change how the game is played in exchange for a point modifier
[*]Statistics to get feedback on how you play
[*]Steam Achievements and Trading Cards
[/list]

Hope to see you all on the leaderboards on March 30th!
